observations: body L3, L6, L10, L18, L29: «28,r.–v.» (5.2 pt), «lvii–lviii» (5.5 pt) and «in–folio» (5.5 pt) have long dashes; the hyphens of «178-186», «293-294», «218-220», «308-309» and «192-195» measure 3.1-3.4 pt and are 1.4-1.5 pt thick, that of «210-211» is of the thinner sort (3.8 pt long and 1.2 pt thick) that also divides words at the ends of lines (L4: 4.0 pt).
body L6, L20, L28: «lvii», «lviii», «xli» and «lxxii» are in small capitals.
body L7-L8, L12, L23-L26: «Antonium» is letter-spaced across the division of the line («An-», «tonium»), and so are «Henry Martin», «aṣ-Ṣūfī» (divided at its hyphen) and «Theone Alexandrino».
body L13-L14: «§ 3.» is bold; «al-Mu‘taḍid» has the turned comma of the ʿayn and the d with a dot below.
body L22: in «ἀσπιδίσκη» the smooth breathing prints joined to the alpha.
notes_left L1-L9: note 1. «lvii» and «ii» are in small capitals, «Rabiçag de Toledo» is letter-spaced. A mark above the t of «sunt» (L3) and a dot below the m of «tiorem» (L5) are specks.

notes_left L10-L15, notes_right L1-L10: note 2, the letter of Henry Martin in French, each line opened by a guillemet; it runs from the left column into the right. «n.o» has a raised o, «bon» a raised on; the raised e of «XVIIe» prints as a dot in notes_left L13 and as an e in notes_right L1. «Croix–» and «là–» divide «Croix-Rousse» and «là-dessus» at long dashes (4.6 pt in this type); the hyphens of the notes measure 2.2-3.8 pt, that of «245-274» 4.1 pt.
notes_right L11-L12: note 3; «al-Ḥaǵǵāǵ» and «aṣ-Ṣūfī» are letter-spaced, the g with the acute as printed.

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
